name: Broken Samophlange
summary: In the northern Barrens, a broken samophlange draws the notice of curious engineers. Its gears and shifting parts hint at a purpose no one has uncovered.

sections.title: A Baffling Mechanism
sections.body: The broken samophlange is a baffling contraption from the northern Barrens. Its moving assemblies and fine gears show careful workmanship, even in ruin. Sputtervalve, a goblin in Ratchet, damaged the delicate device by accident before anyone could document how it worked. The finder hoped to send working results to curious colleagues in Undermine, so they sought someone able to repair it. Wenikee Boltbucket, a clever tinkerer near the border outpost of Mor'shan Rampart, was the one they turned to.

sections.title: Seeking Tinkerer's Hands
sections.body: Wenikee Boltbucket cannot tell what a samophlange is meant to do, even after examining its ruined parts. Its clockwork sounds and shifting motion catch her interest, though. Rather than discard it as junk, she sets out to repair the device and see its mechanisms working at full capacity.

faq.answer: Even the tinkerers trying to repair a samophlange cannot say what it does. Its name offers no answer, but its intricate gears and moving parts point to some unknown industrial purpose.

Sputtervalve, the goblin in Ratchet, damaged the delicate machinery while tampering with the device brought to him. The samophlange seized before its secrets could be shared with colleagues in Undermine, so they sought an expert to get it working again.

Wenikee Boltbucket is an inquisitive tinkerer in the northern Barrens, just south of Mor'shan Rampart on the Ashenvale border. Her engineering curiosity leads her to inspect and rebuild strange contraptions.

faq.q: Why are goblins in Undermine interested in it?
faq.answer: Goblin engineers and entrepreneurs are eager to study unusual mechanical technology. Word of the device reached contacts in Undermine, who were intrigued by whatever advantages it might offer.

angles.text: For an engineer, the samophlange is an irresistible puzzle: a machine with delicate inner gears whose purpose may emerge only by taking it apart and getting it running.
The device turns up in Horde territory in the Barrens, bringing local outposts, tinkerers, and neutral trading contacts into cooperation.
